Noah Kim: Quick check 26: My spouse's green card was issued 2026-01-10 but we just got the physical cards and SSN. Can I add them retro to 2026-01-10? What docs do you need?
Samira Khan: If the green card issuance is the qualifying event date, yes we can try to retro to 2026-01-10. Upload the green card front + back, SSN assignment notice (if you have it), and proof of relationship (marriage cert). If you only have the green card now, upload the copies and we'll start the carrier request.
Noah Kim: Uploaded as "1766123450_noah_spouse_gc.zip" to secure portal. Included GC photos + marriage cert scanned.
BenefitsAdmin: Got it. We'll submit to carriers for backdate request. Carriers sometimes allow backdating to the issuance date but results vary. If carrier declines, coverage will be effective the date of enrollment.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: secure upload link: https://hr.redwood.com/secure-upload. Don't post docs here.
Samira Khan: We'll follow up when carrier responds, usually 3-7 business days. If you need urgent claims coverage, file claims and we can request retro adjudication with the carrier while enrollment is pending.
Noah Kim: Thanks team. I'll ping if I hear anything from my spouse's side.
